{{Quote|If you can simply find some way to ''prove'' you are who you say you are&hellip;?|The Gotal traffic controller's final words to Jango Fett, before being killed|<ref name="BT 1" />}}
A [[Gotal/Legends|Gotal]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] worked as a '''traffic controller''' for the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Atzerri/Legends|Atzerri's]] [[Atzerri Air Traffic Control|Air Traffic Control]] during the final [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], he and his associate, the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Elmyo]], hailed the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett's]] [[Slave I/Legends|ship]] after Fett entered Atzerri's [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]]. Elmyo suggested that Fett begin negotiations for the landing fee, and the Gotal traffic controller apologized for the man's denigration of the famous [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] hunter. The Gotal asked Fett to prove his identity, but the bounty hunter instead launched two [[Missile/Legends|rockets]] at their traffic control [[Starship/Legends|ship]], [[Death/Legends|killing]] both the Gotal and Elmyo.

==Biography==
{{Dialogue|Fett|This is Jango Fett.|Elmyo|Great. Good. You know your own name. Now&hellip;|Gotal traffic controller|Elmyo, are you ''crazy''??|attr=Jango Fett, Elmyo, and the Gotal traffic controller|src=<ref name="BT 1" />}}
A [[Gotal/Legends|Gotal]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] lived during the final [[Time/Legends|decades]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Around the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], he served the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Atzerri/Legends|Atzerri's]] [[Atzerri Air Traffic Control|Air Traffic Control]] as an [[Officer/Legends|officer]], and was training a new recruit, the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Elmyo]].<ref name="BT 1" />

[[File:GotalController2.png|thumb|right|250px|The Gotal traffic controller takes away Elmyo's comlink.]]
During the same year, the Gotal and Elmyo were out on patrol and intercepted the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Slave I/Legends|''Slave I'']], which belonged to the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], after it entered the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] of Atzerri. The Gotal hailed Fett over the traffic control ship's [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]], asking if he had been to Atzerri before. When Fett confirmed that he had, Elmyo suggested that landing fee negotiations begin, but he was interrupted when Fett revealed his identity. As Elmyo, who was unaware of Fett's reputation as a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] hunter, kept talking to the Mandalorian, the Gotal grabbed the comlink from the Human and apologized to Fett for Elmyo's derisive behavior. The Gotal asked Fett to provide proof of his identity, but the Mandalorian responded by launching two [[Missile/Legends|rockets]] at the Gotal's ship. The missiles destroyed the starship, [[Death/Legends|killing]] the Gotal and Elmyo.<ref name="BT 1" />

==Personality and traits==
The Gotal had [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and yellow [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. He was fearful when Jango Fett revealed that he was ''Slave I''{{'s}} [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]]. He berated Elmyo for his attitude toward Fett and was nervous as he asked the Mandalorian to confirm his identity.<ref name="BT 1" />

==Equipment==
The Gotal wore a white [[Jacket/Legends|jacket]].<ref name="BT 1" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Gotal traffic controller appeared in a flashback sequence in the [[Blood Ties 1|first issue]] of the [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] miniseries ''[[Star Wars: Blood Ties]]''. The comic was written by [[Tom Taylor]], illustrated by [[Chris Scalf]],<ref name="BT 1" /> and published on [[August 25]], [[2010]].<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54015/star_wars_blood_ties_2010_1|text=Star Wars: Blood Ties (2010) #1}}</ref>
